figurative_meaning_en: The thread or continuity of speech/conversation
example_sentences_in_bangla: বক্তৃতার খেই ধরে রাখা কঠিন হয়ে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I lost the thread of the conversation.
It's hard to keep the thread of the speech.
note: Often used in the phrase 'কথার খেই' to denote losing track in discussion
